- Source: Volta website, AI Residency page
- Date: none
- Program: AI Residency
- Link: https://voltaeffect.com/ai-residency

Residency is a community of AI founders working toward their first $1M in revenue in 18 months or less.
Eligible startups have at least one founder based in Atlantic Canada (NS, NB, PEI, or NL), commit serious weekly time, and are not primarily hardware- or regulated life-sciences products.
Volta does not provide funding directly to founders.
